FDA agrees that there is the need for therapy that completely suppresses hemolysis during the entire dosing interval in all patients with PNH. Additionally, PNH is a chronic disease that requires life‐long treatment. A therapy that provides for similar efficacy but with reduced burden for patients with frequency of administration would be a benefit to patients.
